name: Takagi Kaede
source:
It may look like Kaede is not thinking about anything, because she is really not thinking about anything. She speaks slowly and her friends often describe her to be "sluggish''. She is the shy girl type, and due to her personality, she has a hard time talking to people of the opposite sex.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
